challenge_facts_addressed.effect_on_judgment: The sustained shift to slower, shorter replies without follow-up questions supports B, but it is also compatible with the unusually low bandwidth reported in C3-F3.
Two cancellations without concrete replacement times materially support B, although the proposed reconnection after the deadline in C3-F3 provides some evidence that the withdrawal is temporary.

Group attendance and online posting while Riley waited for replies suggest selective attention and therefore support B, but the gatherings were brief and do not negate the broader reduction in activities shown by C3-F2.

reason_for_retaining_or_changing: A remains better supported because the change followed identified work and family pressures in C3-F1, extended to other invitations and a normal hobby in C3-F2, and was acknowledged by Sam as unusually low bandwidth with a proposed post-deadline reconnection in C3-F3. C3-F4 through C3-F6 create meaningful evidence for B, so confidence in A is reduced, but they do not outweigh the evidence of broader situational strain.

revised_recommended_action.explanation: Allow for the stated low-bandwidth period and assess whether Sam follows through on reconnecting after the work deadline; if the pattern continues, clarify directly.
